**Finding: deviation (§ 2.1, p0012)**

§ 2.1 binds us to a USD 2,000,000 per year take-or-pay purchase commitment for three years, expressly "without reduction or termination rights." That is the walk-away position under MINCOMMIT and falls short of the fallback (a single 12-month commitment, reducible on 30 days' notice, with a true-up rather than a penalty). It also sits inconsistently with § 12.3, where Vendor acknowledges we have made no minimum-volume commitment, and with § 7.1's bar on unidentified minimum-use charges.

Redline (validated, preferred position): replace the commitment with "Customer has no minimum purchase or take-or-pay commitment. Customer is obligated to pay only for Services it actually uses or orders under an executed Order Form," offering the 12-month / 30-day reduction / true-up structure as a fallback if Cobalt needs a commitment.
